DEPOSITER EDUCATION AND AWARENESS PROGRAMME
Overview
, in collaboration with financial experts and banking institutions, organizes the Depositor Education and Awareness Programme to enhance financial literacy among students and faculty. This initiative aims to educate participants on safe banking practices, financial planning, and the rights and responsibilities of depositors.
The program includes expert-led sessions on topics such as banking regulations, digital transactions, fraud prevention, and investment strategies. Interactive discussions, case studies, and real-world examples help attendees understand the importance of secure financial management. Special emphasis is placed on creating awareness about RBI guidelines, deposit insurance, and grievance redressal mechanisms.
Through this initiative,
empowers students with essential financial knowledge, ensuring they make informed decisions and contribute to a financially aware society.
